items.title: Topo portable lamp by Felix Pöttinger Design Studio for Maytoni
items.summary: A new portable table lamp pairs a cylindrical base with a tiltable disc shade in translucent diffusing material, producing layered shadow and reflection effects on its base.

items.title: Bandit Lites illuminates Neyland Stadium with tribute in light for 25th Anniversary of 9/11
items.summary: A large-scale temporary light installation marked the 25th anniversary of 9/11 at a stadium venue, an example of commemorative large-format lighting design rather than architectural specification work.

items.title: Lee Broom evokes 1970s glamour with The Chant Chambers installation
items.summary: A showroom installation displays a modular glass-block lighting collection across portable lamp, wall lamp, pendant and chandelier formats, styled with a 1970s aesthetic for London Design Festival.
